description: Deterministic nutrition calculation for a recipe (no AI): energy and nutrients per 100 g, micronutrients with %NRV, candidate nutrition claims (withheld if any ingredient is unresolved), allergens and QUID hints. Ingredient lines with mass or volume and the ingredient name in Polish (the food table matches Polish names only; translate other languages first), e.g. "mąka owsiana 500 g", "mleko 200 ml", "miód 50 g". Usage limit: 20 calculations per user per day (500 for shared Google network addresses).

ingredients.description: One ingredient per item: Polish ingredient name, quantity and unit (g, kg, mg, ml, l), e.g. "mleko 200 ml".

product_name.description: Optional product/recipe label shown in the result (max 120 chars).

name: nutrition_calc
title: Calculate a nutrition declaration (Nutrimetr)
